svg.text: IN: THE COPPER, ALL 97 LETTERS, THE 24 KNOWN PLACES IN ACCENT
a Myszkowski key: ABSCISSA ranks its columns A1 B2 S5 C3 I4 S5 S5 A1; columns of equal rank are read together, row by row
rank 5 then runs across columns 3, 6, 7 in each row:
where each known letter lands, and the carved letter there
OUT: NO READING; NOTHING BELOW PERIOD 21
